name: Pika H3 Flex
note: [Pika H3 Flex](https://huggingface.co/Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex) is Pika's six-step post-training of MiniMax H3 for text-to-video and first/last-frame-conditioned generation. Use the canvas image for the first frame and the first enabled moodboard image for the last frame, or omit images for text-to-video. It generates 24 FPS video with synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. Start with a 480- or 768-pixel short side, 6 LCM steps, Text Guidance 1, Shift 12, and Audio Shift 3.
